name: Terminal Dock
description: A pane-scoped composer for recognized terminal agents, with acknowledged serialized sends and durable draft recovery.

setting.title: Enable Terminal Dock
setting.description: Show the independent composer below supported terminal-agent panes.

setting.title: Automatically open supported docks (Experimental)
setting.description: Open the dock for newly recognized supported agent sessions. Existing manual choices are preserved.

method.description: Read the canonical state for a live terminal pane or session. When both selectors are supplied they must identify the same binding.

result.description: The complete canonical DockState, including mounted/passthrough status and the nested attachment, send, question and option records.

view.title: Terminal Dock Composer
view.description: An independent composer hosted below a supported terminal pane.

view.title: Terminal Dock Settings
view.description: Terminal Dock feature and experimental auto-open settings.

command.title: Set Terminal Dock State
command.description: Set pane preferences or replace its draft and attachment selection through the active UI window.

command.title: Toggle Terminal Dock
command.description: Open or close the active supported pane's dock.

command.title: Toggle Terminal Dock Passthrough
command.description: Move keyboard ownership between the composer and terminal.

command.title: Focus Terminal Dock Composer
command.description: Focus the active pane's dock composer.

command.title: Resize Terminal Dock
command.description: Set the dock gutter row count.

command.title: Send Terminal Dock Draft
command.description: Submit the pane's current draft through the acknowledged send queue.

command.title: Cancel Terminal Dock Send
command.description: Cancel queued or active dock sends.

command.title: Handle Terminal Dock Question
command.description: Collapse, dismiss or answer the current provider question.

command.title: Change Terminal Dock Session Option
command.description: Read or change a supported session-only option.

keybinding.description: Toggle the active supported terminal dock.
Toggle local terminal keyboard passthrough while the dock is mounted.

cli-command.summary: read a pane's or session's canonical dock state
set dock preferences or revisioned draft state
report a connection's dock mount, focus and transport state
read or browse pane-scoped prompt history
query slash/skill or workspace-file picker results
attach a readable file or upload bytes
submit a prompt through the serialized acknowledged PTY queue
cancel a selected or current pane send
read, dismiss or answer a pending provider question
read or change a session-only option
inspect, acquire or release a foreign driver lease
toggle a pane's remembered dock request
